Squishy builds will be ult targets for Vi and removing you will leave your back line exposed. If you get hp make sure to get tabi's at the least to have some armor to deal with her % physical damage as high HP only builds will simply be burned by her kit damage. Do not go into unwarded areas if Vi is missing as a bush fully charged Q can easily burst you down and an ally of her's will finish you off. This matchup is entirely dependent on who starts the snowball first.

Build armor to reduce her threat to you, afterwards build knights vow or locket to give your squishy a chance to survive her burst. If they survive her engage and her teammates you can bait her into her own death from there and then work front to back line on her team.

- Volibear's shield applies a slow when it procs, once you see the animation back off to wait out the duration of the shield and the slow it applies.
- Volibear is UNSTOPPABLE during his ult animation, but your stun will still go on cooldown when he procs it. Avoid stunning him during this window.
- Volibear's DPS comes from his Maul (W) applying a second time on the same target. If you cannot kill him between maulings do not fight him.
- Volibear's Q RESETS it's cooldown if he's hard CC'd during it.

Volibear is actually a matchup that can go either way, while Volibear especially who run PTA can easily burst Udyr your ability to shred this champion cannot be underestimated. His desired combo is to lead into a Q, proc his PTA then Maul you for high burst damage. As Aftershock Udyr you can easily eat this opening combo to shred him with your higher DPS. Your raw kit bonus AS is higher then his even with his fully stacked passive, abuse this by stacking monkey's agility for 30% and using Tiger's to shred through him. Once he starts his charge, move to avoid his shield granting ability and if he successfuly obtains the shield continue to attempt to disengage till the shield has worn off befo…

Volibear smashes pure squish builds especially as he can lead a stun and then drop the 2 second delayed E onto you. Volibear wins extended trades due to his sustain from his W and his AoE on his relentless storm passive and this damage can add up. Avoid stacking with your allies as his ultimate both is a powerful AoE and can cancel towers. Do not let allies who are low post six not have your support as his towerdiving potential can easily tilt your solo que teammates.

Armor items are going to be your friend, Volibear's frenzy scales with his bonus health and he rarely stacks armor so make sure to bulk up on your defenses. His W applies a wounded to you for eight seconds where a second W on you will apply the bonus damage and heal. Deny Volibear from getting his shield and peel him from allies, if you force him to dps you instead your allies can be spared. If you start to gain a lead back, a black cleaver will aid your allies in shredding through his health heavy build. Knights Vow and Zeke's Convergence are amazing items to both lower his DPS and slow him from getting to your allies. Remember that SLOWS do not reset his Q's cooldown and if he cannot reach…

- You can cancel Warwick's ult with a well timed stun even if he's ulting you.
- Warwick's E has flat damage reduction, stun him then back off till the CC has gone off.
- Warwick's blood hunt makes him faster to low health targets, make sure to stay healty in your own jungle.

Warwick is a skill matchup that favors Udyr in most elo's if you have proper matchup knowledge. In early brawls open with a stun on Warwick when he attempts to use primal howl then back off. Once the fear has been applied even if you eat it you can outdamage him by turning around then and there. Warwick's early damage and sustain is matched by few but can be abused if you use your first stun during his howl then saving your last stun as he drops below 25% HP. As his healing magnifies on his own HP you'll need to ensure he can't try to outsustain you via his passive and Q's. Objectives come down to which team has priority and who abuses the jungler appearing top during jungle so make sure to …

Do not attack Warwick with his primal howl up, at miminal it'll have 35% damage reduction, add a red smite to the mix and you'll be tickling him to death. Get a form of grevious wounds before you look to trade in the mid game with him as he can play the sustain game.
Get bramble vest to reduce his auto based healing and Q healing and then build up bulky to provide a frontline to your allies. His R stops at the first target hit, if it needs to be you so be it.

- Wukong's stunned before they clone will keep the stun circle, use it to realize who is who.
- Sweeper can reveal him when he goes invis, use this to follow him and keep the fight going.
- Wukong stacks armor off his passive, avoid trades that go on to long.

Wukong has gotten some nerfs but he's still a terror if allowed into the teamfighting phase with a lead. His jungle clear is healthy so instead look to punish him between camps or during a scuttle engage if possible. His ganks lack any CC so try to watch and see if he uses his invis to perform the gank. Without his clone you can easily outdamage him and flash to him if he attempts to get away. Your main concern is when he hits level six as his knockups must be absorbed during any trade. Try your hardest to not be stuck between his clone and the real Wukong by using sweeper and taking the fight away from the Clone's R range. This will greatly reduce his damage and his ability to bring his Q o…

Do not stand on top of his clone and try to outtrade him, he gets lower CD on his Q based off autoattacks between himself and his clone and if he uses his nimbus strike the clone gains the attack speed as well. Once he gains his ultimate avoid standing on top of your allies as his AoE ult applying % damage on top of his clone can easily expose a team to follow up team CC.

Armor items and black cleaver will be your go to for this monkey king. Priotize your defenses as you need to survive his ultimate long enough to stun him and apply a tiger dot for black cleaver to even be useful to your teammates. Sweeper can help your teammates see where he goes after he applies his decoy.

- Xin Zhao will almost always go for lvl 2 ganks, ward and farm up.
- Xin zhao's early damage comes from AA resets and his W, dodge the W and win the trade.
- Xin Zhao falls off, build bulky and make his engages entirely useless.

Xin Zhao is an early game focused jungler of a time long missed. When against this champion focus on working with allies to ward around his red buff so he can't get off his infamous level two ganks, if he wastes time trying to do one over a ward focus on farming and counterjungling him as this will put him terribly behind especially if you steal his blue and deny him yours. LIke udyr he starts machete and losing out on blue means he'll quickly run out of mana. Proper farming rotations will give you an XP lead early which you can then look to counter his ganks as he's an all in champion if the lane matchup allows it. If not, then instead focus on farming quickly for the early game to get into…

Do not try to counter his level two, his is stronger for a reason and he can easily turn on you instead with his ally. Avoid trying to countergank Xin Zhao if his laner is responding better and/or has better early game commitment such as a Kassadin vs a Orianna for example. This is a matchup you win with patience even with Conqueror or PTA as your rune of choice.

Build defensive items and stun Xin zhao when he attempts to engage on you then simply walk away. If he can't knock you up with his Q auto attacks and loses out on the CD his damage and cooldowns go down with it. Stun him after he has thrown out his Q.

- Zac's Q is a lot of his early game damage and lockdown, use a minion or monster to absorb it if you can't dodge it early.
- Zac levels his E first, if he engages with it you can counter him and kill him before it comes off CD.
- If he's low, save smite for his blobs as they count as minions meaning you can oblierate one quickly.

Zac is one of the few tank junglers who actually is quite threatening thanks to the buff of bami cinder working well with his trade patterns. His % damage and tankiness is a rough trade if he counterganks any of your ganks so make sure to keep vision control deep in his jungle to catch this off. Invading him is risky as you'll need to catch him between E cooldowns, if you're not sure save your stun till he attempts to E away to cancel the channel part of the ability.Even if you dodge the E his Q can be applied on a minion, monster or allied champ then he can auto you to pull you both together in CC and slows. If you're standing NEXT to your target you'll take extra damage and be slowed again…

Do not stand next to a target Zac can Q then auto you and vice versa, the extra damage from this on top of eating W's will quickly wear down your health bar giving Zac scary amount of damage. Standing on top of allies should be avoided at all costs as he can land on top of you with E, Q both of you for the high damage, ult both of you all while using constant W's for % max health damage.

Build Black Cleaver for allied damage and begin stacking MR items, Zac unforunately is a great engage for allies so try to stun him just as he lands to try to stall out his Q or ultimate from being used as long as possible.
